API Documentation url: https://docs.pdf.co/

Action
UploadFile
Upload a file to PDF.co temporary cloud storage.

Action
ConvertHTMLToPDF
Convert raw HTML code or a public URL to PDF.

Action
MergePDF
Merge multiple PDFs or supported documents into one PDF.

Action
GetPDFInfo
Get metadata and details about a PDF (page count, author, etc.).

Action
CheckJobStatus
Check the processing status of an async job.

Action
GenerateBarcode
Generate a barcode (QR, Code128, EAN, etc.) as image or PDF.

Action
ReadBarcode
Read barcodes from PDF or image files.

Action
CompressPDF
Compress and reduce the size of a PDF file.

I am planning to build an integration component for pdfco. Could you provide me with a list and description of the most commonly used and essential API endpoints for this service? Specifically, I am interested in endpoints related to core operations. For each endpoint, please include the HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE), the endpoint URL or path, link to documentation, a brief description of its purpose, provide list of inputs. If possible, also mention any authentication requirements.
Create the service json as well, (serviceJson property)
ignore input parameters for pagination, it could be for example page, offset, limit, etc.

Action naming conventions: Try to avoid naming with "List", such as "List Users", "List Contacts" etc. Use "Find" instead. For example "Find Users", "FInd Contacts". These actions have usually input parameters for search, such as "query", "search" or similar.

Provide information about authentication, include type of authentication, and other properties. Provide information about authentication endpoint URL, token URL for managing access token - for obtaining access token and refreshing access token. Provide information about profile info URL, where is possible to get information about current user. It is used for getting user profile information, such as email, name, etc. (authentication property)
